citations.quote: The arithmetic mean weights percentage changes in earnings in each period equally and ignores compounding effects in earnings.
for commodity firms, where cyclical movements in commodity prices can affect earnings, we argue for the use of normalized earnings in valuation.
One limitation of the cyclical/non-cyclical classification is that business-cycle sensitivity is a continuous spectrum rather than an “either/or” issue

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Cyclical firms' reported earnings swing over a multi-year cycle; current-year multiples are misleading. Cycle adjustment normalizes earnings to mid-cycle profitability via averaged historical earnings, normalized margins, or mid-cycle return on capital. CAPE is the canonical instance. Damodaran's Ch.22 covers cyclical-firm normalization; CFA R37 covers cyclicality classification.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Cyclicality and Cycle Adjustment
